extraction.Name: Charlotte Giroux
extraction.Recorded patent: Patent was recorded February 23, 1918, by John Burnett
extraction.Buyer: Charlotte Giroux conveyed the land to J. A. Hutchinson and J. B. Bryan for $4500, of which $1500 is to be paid and the remainder in a year; then on January 10, 1919, Charlotte Giroux Burnett and John Burnett conveyed the same land to Hutchinson and Bryan for $4500 (apparently because the husband did not sign the former deed)
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612446 issued; Lots 3, 4 and 5 and Southeast quarter of Southwest quarter, section 32, township 44, north of range 29; receipt for patent signed by the allottee February 23, 1918; contract for sale made November 20, 1918; first deed signed without husband's signature, corrected by second deed January 10, 1919 with John Burnett also signing; document stamped Rosebud, S.D., JUN 1929
